project_identity.name: Bengaluru Trekkers - Operations Management System
project_identity.aesthetic: Modern Tech x Outdoor Vibrant. High contrast, clean surfaces, electric accents.
principles: Fusion: Technical precision meets outdoor vitality.
Clarity: Data density without clutter. Color is meaning.
Energy: Interactions should feel snappy and alive.
Context: Light mode default for daylight visibility.

design_system.theme_strategy: Light mode default (Best for data density/daylight). Dark mode toggle available.

primary.name: Electric Summit
primary.usage: Primary buttons, active states, key highlights

secondary.name: Trail Green
secondary.usage: Success states, completion markers, positive trends

headings.usage: All section headers, page titles, card titles. CRITICAL: Import Manrope from Google Fonts.

visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-xl (12px) for cards, rounded-lg (8px) for buttons/inputs

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-lg shadow-primary/20 transition-all active:scale-95
buttons.outline: border-2 border-slate-200 hover:border-primary hover:text-primary bg-transparent text-slate-600

cards.style: bg-white border border-slate-100 shadow-sm rounded-xl overflow-hidden hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300

inputs.style: bg-slate-50 border-slate-200 focus:bg-white focus:border-primary focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/20 rounded-lg h-10 transition-all

badges.base: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium

tables.header: bg-slate-50 text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold text-xs py-3 px-4

sidebar.style: Fixed left, full height, dark theme (slate-900) for contrast against light content area.

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALLATION: Run `yarn add lucide-react date-fns recharts react-day-picker` if not present.
CRITICAL: Set default font to Inter in Tailwind config, but use Manrope for all headings (h1-h6).
AUTH: Hardcode initial admin email in logic (e.g., 'admin@bengalurutrekkers.com'). All other signups require approval status.
COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn UI for complex interactions (Calendar, Dialog, Popover). Customize them to match the 'Alpine Electric' palette.
LAYOUT: Use a sidebar layout for the authenticated area. Login page should be a split screen (Image Left / Form Right).
FORMS: Use react-hook-form + zod for validation. Display errors in red text below inputs.
DATA: All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes.
ACCESSIBILITY: Ensure text contrast ratios are met. Use 'text-slate-900' on light backgrounds for body text.
universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical grids.
Every interaction needs a micro-animation (scale, color shift).
Avoid gradients for text. Use solid, high-contrast colors.
Use 'recharts' for any data visualization (bookings per month, etc.).
